\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
The loop that empties Verm1's map can be made faster in five ways, and each is a machine of its own. The question an engineer asks is not which machine is fastest, but which is sufficient.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item The loop that empties Verm1's map executes 3,840 instructions at about one cycle each on a 160 MHz clock. How long does it take? Name one way to reduce each of the three factors.
\item A program is 80\% parallel. With as many processors as you like, what is the largest speed-up, and why?
\end{enumerate}
\end{chapstatus}
